verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own channel docs mention access controls for WhatsApp, and the Telegram page says it sets who is allowed to use the bot, so the product does document some sender gating. The evidence is limited to page descriptions and shows no detail on how gating works. Missing for 10: explicit sender allowlist configuration, documented DM policy options, mention gating for groups, cross-channel consistency of gating, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
